integrity: All source claims were separated from the new recurrence analysis; the source itself states only non-elementarity of its procedure, not the tower-height asymptotic.
limitations: The theorem analyzes the source's explicit upper-bound function B(s), not the optimal finite-model size or the true decision-problem complexity.
It proves no matching lower bound for ITL^e and is compatible with a different elementary construction.
The recurrence analysis is short enough that uncatalogued folklore remains an originality risk.
title: The published \(\mathsf{ITL}^e\) finite-model bound has linear tower height
